- Mergeable quantile sketches (KLL/PCM)


## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design dynamic approximate SPTs under batched updates, balancing accuracy and update cost, a realistic concern for large-scale graphs in production.

## Key Concepts
- (1+ε)-approximate SPT maintenance
- Batch-driven relaxations with local propagation
- Periodic full rebuild to bound drift
- Time/memory trade-offs; practical optimizations

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-code sketch
initializeSPT(r);
for each batch B:
  relaxEdges(B);
  if (batchIndex % T === 0) rebuildSPTFromScratch();
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How to choose T to optimize long-term cost?
- How would you adapt to edge deletions or negative-weight adjustments?
